senses.gloss: ch. sameto move, tremble; hesitate. Targ. O. a. Y. II Ex. XX, 15.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 13:17">Targ. O. ib. XIII, 17</cite> (h. text <he>ינחם</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:22">Ab. V, 22</cite> <he>מינה לא תָזוּעַ</he> thou shalt not move (deviate) from it (the Law).—Part. <cite ref="G00218"><he>זָיַיע</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 4:24">Targ. Jer. IV, 24</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> <he>מן … לית את ז׳</he> thou shalt never leave my palace.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 6:24">Targ. Y. Num. VI, 24</cite> <cite ref="M00754"><he>מְזַיְּיעֵי</he></cite> frightening demons.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 26:19">Targ. Y. Lev. XXVI, 19</cite> (cmp. Sifra a. l., quot. in <cite ref="G00217">preced. w.</cite>); <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:23">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 23</cite> <he>מְזִיעַ</he> (Af.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 8:12">Targ. Jud. VIII, 12</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְזָעָא</he>, f. <he>מְזָעֲתָא</he>.
